name: What is the process for adding a second story to my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for adding a second story to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and needs. Following this, we move to design and architectural planning, ensuring compliance with local zoning and building codes. Next, structural engineering assessments are performed, and permits are secured. Construction then commences, involving foundation reinforcement, framing, roofing, interior finishes, and final inspections. Throughout, we maintain transparent communication and project management.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, engineering, permitting, construction, and final inspections, with clear communication at every stage.
